prank_description: Hector swapped Kaio's scout compass with one slightly recalibrated by the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear.
summary: Hector intended to hand the pranked compass to Kaio during the fierce storm, but Kaio missed the catch and it hit Ryn instead.
narrative_prose: Hector stabilized his stance, the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea screaming against the hull as he tasted the static tang of the atmosphere. The thick metallic tang of ozone stung his nose, and the deafening roar of the shear made communication nearly impossible, so he reached to CONCEAL his tools in his heavy jacket. 'Kaio, grab this compass!' he bellowed, thrusting the pranked scout compass into Kaio's waiting hand, but Kaio missed the perfectly timed physical handoff amidst the chaos, failing to DEFEND the Enclave's structural integrity before the sheer force could CONSUME their grip on the railing, and the compass hit Ryn instead.
science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea

active_location.macro_silhouette: The reinforced deck overlooking the ferrofluid sea shuddered under the immense pressure of the storm. Pylons strained visibly against the violent, dark waves crashing around them. A single, heavy iron baton served as the critical junction point between the two engineers.

sensory_palette.sight_and_color: Bruising violet and orange skies contrasting with dark, oily waves.
sensory_palette.sound: Howling wind and a vibrating metallic hum.
sensory_palette.tactile_temperature: A sudden, sharp drop in temperature accompanied by stinging sea spray.
sensory_palette.taste_optional: The bitter tang of static on the tongue.

interactive_features.affordance_description: Can be monitored to stabilize the pressure.
Threatens to engulf the lower deck.
Can pull loose equipment to safety.

reactive_toys.consistent_method: Battering the structure with highly magnetic waves.
reactive_toys.immediate_complication: Causes wild fluctuations in the pressure gauges.
reactive_toys.uninterrupted_escalation: Tears the main control console from its moorings.

three_levels_of_why.level_2_local: The pylons must hold to save the Forge.
three_levels_of_why.level_3_campaign_arc: The Enclave's survival depends on mastering the magnetosphere.
